flags.label: Only load Devtest map
flags.description: Only include the tiny map Devtest, no other zlevels. Boots way faster.

flags.label: I'm really in a hurry
flags.description: All of the below: skips FEA/mining/planet/camera setup, skips changelogs, and auto-readies up.

flags.label: Skip atmos setup
flags.description: Skip setting up atmospheric system.

flags.label: Skip mining level setup
flags.description: Skip generation of mining level.

flags.label: Skip planet setup
flags.description: Skip planet generation (for Artemis).

flags.label: Skip camera coverage
flags.description: Skip calculating security camera coverage.

flags.label: Skip changelogs
flags.description: Skip changelogs.

flags.label: Auto-ready up
flags.description: Automatically ready up and start the game ASAP. No input required.

flags.label: Disable __build.local.dm
flags.description: Don't load things defined in '__build.local.dm'. Use if you have some breaking changes in there or whatnot. Note: this build-flags picker writes its selections into __build.local.dm, so enabling this flag will suppress every other flag you've selected here.

flags.label: Everyone gets captain ID
flags.description: All IDs are captain rank, kept separate from below options to avoid disrupting access-related tests.

flags.label: Captain IDs get all access
flags.description: Captain level ID's have EVERY access.

flags.label: No targetable cooldowns
flags.description: Disables all /datum/targetable cooldowns.

flags.label: Bonus points
flags.description: Gives a bunch of starting points to various abilities/uplinks/weapon vendors.

flags.label: Force medal grants
flags.description: Causes has_medal to always return true - good for testing medal rewards etc.

flags.label: Show status effects
flags.description: Incredibly hacky visible status effects.

flags.label: Ignore player minimums
flags.description: Override game mode minimum player requirements for testing revs, nukies etc.

flags.label: Spawn as a specific job
flags.description: Spawn as a 'imcoder' job. Gives CE belt, captain ID, etc. Edit __build.local.dm directly afterwards if you want a different job ID.

flags.label: Spawn as an antagonist
flags.description: Spawn as the matching antagonist role as defined in _std/defines/roles.dm. Defaults to traitor; edit __build.local.dm directly for a different role.

flags.label: No admin speech modules
flags.description: Loads the admin speech and listen module trees without any modules.

flags.label: No pregame HTML lobby
flags.description: Don't spawn the HTML pregame browser lobby screen.

flags.label: Gene research cheat
flags.description: Marks nearly all genes as researched, gives chromosomes/materials/autodecryptors, increases gene storage cap, and removes time/cost limitations on the gene console.

flags.label: Enable Z log
flags.description: Enable additional world.log logging.

flags.label: Stop distracting me
flags.description: All of the below: no secbots/guardbuddies/bots, no monkeys, no clone prebake, instant clones, low security, no critters, no random rooms/events, no shuttle calls, hackerman, more runtime checks, quick mob deletion, no wage/mail/ghostdrone messages, unbreakable lights, no antag popups.

flags.label: No secbots/guardbuddies
flags.description: Prevents all secbots and guardbuddies from spawning, useful for gun testing.

flags.label: No bots
flags.description: Prevents ALL bots from spawning (not cyborgs).

flags.label: No landmark monkeys
flags.description: Prevents landmark monkeys from spawning - monkeys can still be vended etc.

flags.label: No clone prebake
flags.description: Don't prebake clones.

flags.label: Instant clones
flags.description: Clonepods fully heal the clone instantly.

flags.label: Low security
flags.description: Deletes turrets.

flags.label: No critters
flags.description: Deletes mob critters.

flags.label: No random rooms
flags.description: Don't generate random rooms. Random room areas will be left blank and the landmark will be visible.

flags.label: No random events
flags.description: Don't spawn random events.

flags.label: No shuttle calls
flags.description: Don't autocall the shuttle.

flags.label: Hackerman varedit
flags.description: Lets you varedit things you normally couldn't (admin holders, server config).

flags.label: Check more runtimes
flags.description: Enables checking for some additional errors which might be too costly on live server. Also implied by CI_RUNTIME_CHECKING in CI.

flags.label: Quick mob deletion
flags.description: Enables deleting mobs with build mode right click on obj place mode.

flags.label: No wage PDA messages
flags.description: Disables PDA messages from the wage system.

flags.label: No crew mail
flags.description: Disables random crew mail system.

flags.label: No ghostdrone factories
flags.description: Prevents ghostdrone factory objs from doing stuff.

flags.label: Unbreakable lights
flags.description: Stops lights from breaking or burning out when spawning or turning on/off.

flags.label: No antag popups
flags.description: Stops antag popups from coming up at the start of every game.

flags.label: Tracy profiler hook
flags.description: Enables the hook for the DM Tracy profiler in world/init(), read the code guide.

flags.label: Profile full round
flags.description: Generate and save profiler data for the entire round.

flags.label: Profile pregame
flags.description: Generate and save profiler data for pregame work (before "Welcome to pregame lobby").

flags.label: Profile in-game only
flags.description: Generate and save profiler data for post-pregame work.

flags.label: Delete queue debug
flags.description: This is expensive. Don't turn it on on the server unless you want things to be bad and slow.

flags.label: Update queue debug
flags.description: Probably don't turn it on on a real server but also I have no idea what an update queue is vOv.

flags.label: Image deletion debug
flags.description: DO NOT ENABLE THIS ON THE SERVER FOR FUCKS SAKE.

flags.label: Machine processing debug
flags.description: Apparently not that hefty but still.

flags.label: Queue worker statistics
flags.description: Probably hefty.

flags.label: Local test auth
flags.description: Enable local authentication using a dummy version of the goonhub authentication process.

flags.label: Don't auto-admin
flags.description: Don't automatically grant admin to all localhost connections.

flags.label: Abstract violation: crash
flags.description: Makes the code crash when an abstract type is instantiated. See _stadlib/_types.dm for details.

flags.label: Abstract violation: warn
flags.description: Makes the code log a warning when an abstract type is instantiated. See _stadlib/_types.dm for details.

flags.label: Log hard delete references
flags.description: Makes the delete queue go through every single datum in the game when a hard del happens. It gets reported to the debug log. This process takes about 4 minutes per hard deletion (during that time the server will be frozen).

flags.label: Log hard delete references, electric boogaloo
flags.description: Same as Log hard delete references, electric boogaloo.

flags.label: dispose() is qdel()
flags.description: Toggle this to turn .dispose() into qdel(). Useful for trying to find lingering references locally.

flags.label: Perspective editor walls
flags.description: Toggle this to enable perspective wall icons in .dmm-compatible map editors. By default, icons in the editor will be flat.
